title: The concurrency test passes on every completed full-suite run
statement: On Windows 11 with Node v24.18.0, with lock acquisition retrying EEXIST only, running `node --test` over the full suite, the separate-process concurrency test passes on every completed run. One failing completed run falsifies this.
notes: Scoped to the pre-fix code on 2026-08-18 during stage 3. As first written it named no code version, so EVD-0003 — an observation of the pre-fix system — would have gone on refuting a claim readers would take to be about the current one. An assertion about software behaviour needs the software in its targetEnvironment, or evidence outlives the thing it was about (#79's staleness, arriving through scope rather than through timing).
